data.camera: cowboy shot, hand on sword hilt looking across red wasteland
data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 魔大陆同行】荒芜的魔大陆旷野上，艾莉丝握紧剑柄警惕地环视四周，厚实的冒险者外套在热风中鼓起，红发被吹得凌乱却不减锐气——「敢挡路的，一剑劈了便是。」
data.promptProse: Eris advances alertly across the Demon Continent wasteland, one hand firmly on her sword hilt while the sheath stays at her belt. Practical Dead End jacket, trousers and boots accompany red hair pulled by hot wind. The cowboy view follows barren red earth toward distant ridges, dust moving near the path. Harsh daylight brightens jacket shoulders and the hilt, leaving deep creases and sharp stone shadows across the exposed terrain.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 魔大陆同行
